answer: Proposal: one epoch-stamped credential per person verified face-to-face; the chain honors only the current stamp — one seat per human per epoch. Issuances are published, visible from any knoll: anyone holding two credentials naming one person proves the duplicate and slashes the issuer's locked bond. That bond, hard as marble, is not withdrawable; while it tops one head's lifetime reward, selling duplicates loses — even a buyer can claim the bounty, like a raven finding carrion. Extra heads cost one verification each, one-for-one. Weak seam: inventing unverified persons.
